title: fuse_as_graphmodule change the partitioned exported program input order
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug We notice the ExportedProgram partitioner may change input order. For example, for inputs in origin EP sent to Partitioner is [input_ids, attention_mask]. However, the EP sent to backend preprocess become [attention_mask, input_ids]. After analysis, the root cause comes from one function in the torch side. The workflow for partition is below: 1. Executorch partitioner gives each node a tag, meaning they can be grouped into a partition. 2. The ExecuTorch partitioner will call torch fuse_as_graphmodule to fuse nodes with same tag. 3. fuse_as_graphmodule will follow the visit order from nodes passed, to create the new placeholder in new graph. 4. Since the passed in nodes first use attention_mask, the input order of ExportedProgram in graph become [attention_mask, input_ids] https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/2507ae63f293354170695fd20a5c5ce5f64e323d/torch/fx/passes/utils/fuser_utils.py I prepare a script to reproducible the issue: https://gist.github.com/chenweng-quic/80bf4b957552a87d792c4d6c36a8dec4 Simply run ```shell python test_partition.py ``` You will see result below: ### Versions ### Versions Collecting environment information...
